newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks consolidate as other markets fall.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks consolidate as other markets fall.

text.p: Spanish stocks ended lower on Thursday, dragged down by fellow European and U.S. markets, as investors took profits and the market consolidated after its recent race higher.

"It's good that the market rests and regroups somewhat before making another attempt higher, although if there isn't sizeable improvement abroad it's going to be difficult for us to break 7,200 points in the IBEX," a foreign broker said.
* The general index fell 5.64 points, or 0.90 percent, to 621.57. The Ibex-35 registered a decline of 69.55 points, or 0.97 percent, to 7,095.16.
